$description: Apollo Supercharge override set (ADR-0011 + ADR-0014). Since 2026-07-22 Supercharge carries its OWN warm neutral ramp: the neutral DNA tier (color/neutral/1-15) rebinds here onto color/warm/* — page, ink, surfaces, borders and disabled greys all follow by step index. Status/RAG + dataviz stay identical to Mono (only Legacy differs). State mechanism = colour by default (registry stateMechanism; opacity only where it snaps to a warm step). Dark-mode values are index-symmetric PROPOSALS (provisional-agent, Dave review sheet 2026-07-22) — 'we can always change.'

progress/complete.$note: FIRST Supercharge divergence (Dave 2026-07-21, showroom progress-tracker review: 'in mono and console it should be black. the colours in legacy and supercharge are fine') — Mono/Console went to the ink pair; Supercharge KEEPS the status-red pair it displayed at ruling time. Supersedes this file's 'deliberately EMPTY' description for this one path; Supercharge ≡ Mono everywhere else.

color/neutral/1.$note: warm/1 = #000000 = mono/1 — no-op by value; declared for the complete 15-step binding.

color/neutral/4.$note: ADR-0014 ANCHOR REMAP (Dave ruled 2026-07-22: SC ink = #13110E, 'just use this we can always change'). neutral/4 is the Mono anchor step (ink = digital-black = action fill = mono/4); Supercharge's anchor is ITS step 2 — the warm ramp packs dark, so index-identity would land the anchor a shade light (warm/4 #25211C, L~33 vs mono/4 L~26). Every anchor-bound role (ink, dark page, primary action fill) follows this one line.

color/neutral/raise-1.$note: CALCULATED (provisional-agent, ADR-0014 review sheet): mono elevation deltas (+5/+9/+13 per channel over the dark ground) applied to warm/4 #25211C. Dave to review; 'we can always change.'

color/neutral/raise-2.$note: CALCULATED (provisional-agent, ADR-0014 review sheet): mono elevation deltas (+5/+9/+13 per channel over the dark ground) applied to warm/4 #25211C. Dave to review; 'we can always change.'

color/neutral/raise-3.$note: CALCULATED (provisional-agent, ADR-0014 review sheet): mono elevation deltas (+5/+9/+13 per channel over the dark ground) applied to warm/4 #25211C. Dave to review; 'we can always change.'

tabs/inactive.$note: ADR-0014/R-D23 refinement (Dave's Ally reminder, 2026-07-22 post-push): inactive is INTERACTIVE, not disabled — must pass 4.5:1. The DNA index (warm/10 #806E65) sits 3.89:1 on the SC dark page → dark = warm/11 #AA9B92 (7.01:1). Light restates the DNA value warm/7 #493F39 (9.47:1) because a per-mode override must carry BOTH modes (loader falls back to MONO base, not the theme's DNA). PROVISIONAL-AGENT like all SC dark values — on the review sheet.
